header: A named person as the first contact
lead: Portrait, name, role, a quote in their own words and two ways to reach them. The quote sits in a figure, so the name is linked to the words.
author: The name goes in author
role: The job title goes in role
quote_text: Put a sentence in their own words in quote_text. It should sound like something they would say out loud.
note: Use a current photo of the real colleague. A stock portrait next to a direct line loses the trust this panel should build.
